main.description: Withdraws a designation — the counterpart to org.buildguild.designation and the generalization of governance's 'remove'. Needed because authority-based revocation is cross-repo: an officer can revoke a membership/role another officer granted, and you can't delete a record in someone else's repo. Honored iff the author either is the original grantor OR holds authority to grant the target's capability at its scope (i.e. could have issued it) — and (for chained grants) sits at or above it. Self-withdrawal of one's own grant may instead just delete/supersede the designation; this record exists for the cross-party case and for an explicit, append-only trail. Targets a specific designation by strongRef, or every matching grant by (grantee, capability, scope). Author is the revoker (repo owner). Written to the revoker's repo.

target.description: The specific org.buildguild.designation being revoked (precise form).

grantee.description: Match form: revoke grants to this DID (with capability + scope) when a precise `target` isn't referenced.

capability.description: Match form: the capability being revoked, e.g. 'role:member', 'role:officer', 'quest.transact'.

scope.description: Match form: the scope the revocation applies to (guild id / AT-URI / '*').

reason.description: Optional human note — part of the public trail (e.g. the 'reason' a graduated sanction records).
